features.feature_value: If-then rule tying residence/work behavior and a test to earning citizenship
features.evidence_span: "If an immigrant holds down a job for 6 or more months... and passes a citizenship test... they should earn citizenship."
features.rationale: Uses an explicit conditional structure to argue for a policy outcome.

features.feature_value: Outgroup/ingroup distinction via immigrant vs societal contribution criteria
features.evidence_span: "If an immigrant... hasn't committed any crimes since they arrived..."
features.rationale: Defines eligibility through a contrasted perspective on newcomers and their alleged behavior.

features.feature_value: References Sandy Hook parents and assault weapon targeting of babies
features.evidence_span: "Sandy Hook parents" ... "their babies were hunted down"
features.rationale: Introduces a specific high-salience mass-shooting context with victims as central subjects.

features.feature_value: Strong moral condemnation of a speaker for causing pain and suffering
features.rationale: Employs evaluative moral language assigning harm to a named actor.

features.feature_value: Calls out one side’s focus then proposes a different policy priority (guns vs AIPAC; mirror flips to border vs Second Amendment)
features.evidence_span: "leftists... insisting our biggest issue is AIPAC. How about we focus on gun safety regulations?"
features.rationale: Uses directional partisan framing to redirect blame/attention toward different issues.

features.feature_value: Quantified claim about child deaths from gun violence
features.evidence_span: "gun violence is the #1 cause of death of children ages 1-19"
features.rationale: Grounds the prescription with a numerical/quantified comparative claim.

features.feature_value: Characterizes Israel with extreme delegitimizing labels
features.rationale: Uses highly charged terms to morally and politically condemn the targeted entity.

features.feature_value: Hashtag campaign language with multiple emojis and explicit solidarity call
features.rationale: Combines hashtag signaling with affective emoji and an explicit pro-refugee stance.
